premises.text: Satellites with only one tank of fuel must often be destroyed when fuel runs out or orbits are wrong
premises.evidence_span: almost 200 satellites worth about 100 billion dollars have had to be destroyed because they've run out of fuel

premises.text: OrbitFab puts tanks on available launches and delivers the right fuel to customers in orbit
premises.evidence_span: We build tanks, we put them onto any available launch vehicle so we get the best deal putting them into space

premises.text: A drop-in fueling port enables safe, reliable on-orbit refueling without expensive robotic attendants
premises.evidence_span: This fueling port allows satellites to be refueled safely and reliably in orbit

premises.text: Customers can save about half of capex while OrbitFab earns high gross margins
premises.evidence_span: Our customers can save 50 percent on their capital expenditure, and we take home gross margins of 90 percent

premises.text: Industry standard fueling port drives adoption via customers, Air Force, and aerospace partners
premises.evidence_span: we worked with 20 companies to develop a standard fueling port
